component.name: Inktyset
component.summary: Handwritten math to LaTeX or Typst

description.p: Add photos, scans or PDFs of your handwritten notes. Inktyset reads each page with a vision model that runs on your own computer, compiles it, and shows the scan next to the LaTeX and the rendered page, so you can proofread page by page, then copy the LaTeX or Typst into your thesis or save one file. Nothing you add leaves your computer.

ul.li: Hundreds of pages read in order, on your machine
Every page compiled and shown rendered, not just text that looks right
The Compare view: the scan and the rendered page side by side, with linked zoom and scrolling
A LaTeX editor with highlighting, search and completion
English, French, Arabic and other languages, and pages that mix scripts
Every reading kept: compare two versions and keep the one you prefer
Photos from your phone over your Wi-Fi with Folder Camera (optional, off by default)

description.p: On first start Inktyset downloads its model (Qwen3.5 9B, about 6.6 GB) from Hugging Face. It runs best on a graphics card with Vulkan; it needs at least 8 GB of memory.

screenshot.caption: The Compare view: a handwritten formula above its compiled LaTeX, the editor on the right
The page list: scans, their LaTeX in a highlighting editor, and compiled previews

description.p: Compare: Link (K) scrolls the handwritten page and the preview together, or each on its own; linking them again lines them up.
Go to the source (a Settings option): Ctrl+click the preview to find its line in the text, and a line's place on the preview, for LaTeX and Typst.

ul.li: Compare: the editor and the chat can be resized, and the sides swapped.
Read again works on many pages at once, replacing their text or keeping both.
Closing while pages wait to be read asks whether to keep reading.

description.p: Ready for Flathub: a package can include the engine, Tectonic and Typst, and then only the model is downloaded.
The page chat knows colour works, says only the changes it makes, and answers in your language.
The page chat answers questions without changing the page.
The page chat shows a change as it is written.
Ask the model about a page, in the Compare view.
Stop a page, and fix its picture: turn, straighten, crop.
